title: feat: add deterministic PR publisher
summary: Adds the bounded network-writing adapter that publishes an exact checkpointed feature branch and draft PR for independent platform merge review.
changeNotes: Composes the read-only deterministic checkpoint with the existing publish-lane guard and a host-authenticated GitHub CLI session.
Allows only ordinary feature-branch push plus draft PR create or title/body update.
Binds sender and GitHub receiver state into a verifiable transport receipt.
riskNotes: This is an EXPERIMENTAL HIGH-risk network-writing adapter and requires an exact one-use confirmation.
If push succeeds but PR confirmation fails, it preserves a typed partial receipt and never rewinds remote state automatically.
followUps: Platform Axiom/Mir independently reviews and may merge; local Keel preserves supply for engineering.
Technical merge does not promote the module or change AXM roots or CANON.
